synthesis_recap: We have had 3 confirmed X200 base-seal leaks, all from the X200-2503 batch. The common factor across all three units is the base gasket, which is undersized. We are escalating to the supplier and will keep OPS-481 open until 100% of kits are delivered and we have 30 days with zero new leak reports.
